description: collapse and independence (evaluate-v1-r3, P16-C-02, P16-L-08): audit with 2 attempts of question qa (attempt 2 first in the file, verified 3 of 4, not abstained; attempt 1 last in the file, no claims, abstained with code NO_EVIDENCE) and 1 attempt of question qb (verified 3 of 4): collapsed into 2 answers keeping attempt 2 of qa by attempt number, not file order, so the dropped attempt's abstention and code are not counted; the 2 kept answers have equal ratios, so every bootstrap bound equals the point value, and abstention 0 of 2 has Wilson bounds 0 and z^2/(2+z^2); the 2 demo answers answer distinct questions (equal ratios; demo-b has no evidence list), so their all-claims rates keep the bootstrap and the abstention rate keeps Wilson; only demo-a has claims citing coauthor_edge or metric evidence, so those claim-type rows (1 answer with claims in the set) are descriptive with empty interval cells and the note 'descriptive; 1 answer(s) with claims in this set, ...' where evaluate-v1-r2 wrote a zero-width bootstrap interval; no --label, so the code version labels are not available
